name: F3b.10 the governance page shows the seeded database's request count and agreement rate, as loke computed them from the rows
js: await (async()=>{const d=await window.refreshLayerMetrics();const a=document.getElementById('lm-agreement').textContent;const sub=document.getElementById('lm-agreement-sub').textContent;const n=document.getElementById('lm-requests').textContent;return (d&&d.recorded===true&&document.getElementById('lm-status').hidden&&!document.getElementById('lm-body').hidden&&n==='3'&&a==='33.3%'&&sub.indexOf('1 of 3 detections found by every voting layer, over 2 request(s)')===0)||JSON.stringify({n,a,sub,d});})()

name: F3b.10 detections by layer per day: exactly the seeded rows, day by day
F3b.10 detections by layer and entity type: ner PERSON 1/1, regex email 3/3
F3b.10 every figure on the page is the one /api/layermetrics answered; the page computes none of its own
js: await (async()=>{const d=await (await fetch('/api/layermetrics',{cache:'no-store'})).json();await window.refreshLayerMetrics();const rows=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#lm-days tr'));const bad=d.by_layer_day.filter((x,i)=>{const r=rows[i];return !r||r.dataset.day!==x.day||r.dataset.layer!==x.layer||r.children[2].textContent!==String(x.requests)||r.children[3].textContent!==String(x.detections);});return (rows.length===d.by_layer_day.length&&bad.length===0&&document.getElementById('lm-agreement').textContent===d.agreement.rate&&document.getElementById('lm-requests').textContent===String(d.requests))||JSON.stringify({bad,rows:rows.length});})()

name: F3b.10 latency percentiles per layer: ner 2 scans p50 35 p95 40 p99 40, regex 3 scans at 0 ms (the unavailable NER row is not a scan), each equal to the route's

F3b.10 the time window selector: the seeded rows are from January 2026, so the last 24 hours, 7 days and 30 days show 'No requests recorded in ...' and loke says recorded false for each; All time shows the 3 requests again
js: await (async()=>{const sel=document.getElementById('lm-window');const out={};for(const w of ['24h','7d','30d']){sel.value=w;const d=await window.refreshLayerMetrics();const st=document.getElementById('lm-status');out[w]={rec:d&&d.recorded,period:d&&d.period,req:d&&d.requests,hidden:document.getElementById('lm-body').hidden,st:st.textContent,label:document.getElementById('lm-period').textContent};}sel.value='all';const a=await window.refreshLayerMetrics();const back=a&&a.recorded===true&&a.requests===3&&document.getElementById('lm-requests').textContent==='3'&&!document.getElementById('lm-body').hidden&&document.getElementById('lm-period').textContent==='recorded by loke, all time';const good=['24h','7d','30d'].every(w=>out[w].rec===false&&out[w].period===w&&out[w].req===0&&out[w].hidden&&/^No requests recorded in the last/.test(out[w].st)&&/recorded by loke, the last/.test(out[w].label));return (good&&back)||JSON.stringify({out,back,a});})()

name: F3b.10 the window reaches loke through moke's relay: loke's own answer for ?window=24h counts no seeded request and ?window=all counts all three, and moke refuses a window that is not letters and digits
js: await (async()=>{const w24=await (await fetch('/api/layermetrics?window=24h',{cache:'no-store'})).json();const wall=await (await fetch('/api/layermetrics?window=all',{cache:'no-store'})).json();const bad=await fetch('/api/layermetrics?window=24h%2F..',{cache:'no-store'});const badb=await bad.json();const unk=await fetch('/api/layermetrics?window=1y',{cache:'no-store'});return (w24.recorded===false&&w24.requests===0&&w24.since_ms>Date.now()-86400000-120000&&wall.requests===3&&wall.since_ms===0&&bad.status===400&&badb.relayed_by==='moke'&&unk.status===400)||JSON.stringify({w24,wall,bad:bad.status,unk:unk.status});})()
